name: Freelance UK Hub Slider
author: Freelance UK Hub

sections.description:
Freelance UK Hub Slider allows you to create multiple image sliders and manage their slides from the WordPress admin area.

Each slider can have its own settings and can be displayed anywhere on your website using a shortcode.

Features

  • Create multiple sliders.
  • Add multiple slides to each slider.
  • Select images from the WordPress Media Library.
  • Drag and drop slides to change their order.
  • Enable or disable individual slides.
  • Add slide titles and descriptions.
  • Add buttons with custom text and URLs.
  • Open button links in the same tab or a new tab.
  • Choose left, center, or right content alignment.
  • Enable or disable image overlays.
  • Configure overlay opacity.
  • Configure autoplay.
  • Configure autoplay speed.
  • Show or hide navigation arrows.
  • Show or hide navigation dots.
  • Pause autoplay when hovering over the slider.
  • Choose slide or fade transition.
  • Configure title typography.
  • Configure description typography.
  • Configure button typography and colors.
  • Configure desktop/tablet slider height.
  • Configure mobile slider height.
  • Responsive layout for different screen sizes.
  • Use a separate shortcode for each slider.

Shortcode

After creating a slider, copy the shortcode shown on the Sliders page.

Example:

[fukhs_slider id=”123″]

Replace 123 with the ID of your slider.

The shortcode can be added to WordPress pages, posts, widgets, or other areas that support shortcodes.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the freelance-uk-hub-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Slider in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Click Add New Slider and create a slider.
  5. Open Manage Slides for the slider.
  6. Add your slides and configure the slide content.
  7. Open Settings to configure the slider.
  8. Copy the generated shortcode.
  9. Add the shortcode to the page where you want the slider to appear.
sections.faq:
How do I create a slider?

Go to Slider > Add New Slider, enter a slider name, and save it.

How do I add slides to a slider?

Open the slider from the Slider page and click Manage Slides.

How do I display a slider?

Use the shortcode generated for the slider.

Example:

[fukhs_slider id=”123″]

Can I create more than one slider?

Yes. You can create multiple sliders, and each slider can contain its own slides and settings.

Can I change the order of slides?

Yes. Open Manage Slides, drag the slides into the desired order, and save the order.

Can I disable a slide without deleting it?

Yes. Slides can be enabled or disabled from the slide management screen.

Can I configure each slider separately?

Yes. Each slider has its own settings for autoplay, navigation, transitions, overlay, typography, and responsive height.
